<thought>All given pairwise resistance measurements between nodes N_c1, N_c2, N_c3, X2, and X3 are perfectly satisfied by a simple series chain of four resistors: X2‑R1‑N_c1‑R2‑N_c2‑R3‑N_c3‑R4‑X3. Solving from the measurements gives R1 = 5 Ω, R2 = 10 Ω, R3 = 15 Ω, R4 = 20 Ω, which sum to the measured X2‑X3 resistance of 50 Ω and match every other listed measurement. Therefore the circuit topology is a series ladder with those resistor values.</thought>
